releases.displayName: Exophobia: Fire & Ice Expedition - Content Update Announcement

items.text: Just announced during BoomStock, a new content update that will bring a whole new adventure!
Set in the world of Exophobia, play a new short adventure, set prior to the events in the main game.
Play as the I.S.A ship scientist, as you explore a cave deep in the alien planet. Fight new enemies and face new challenges - can you make it out alive?
It's still very early in development, but it has been fun revisiting the game world :)
This short adventure will bring fresh mechanics, so if you want MORE Exophobia, don't miss this update!

I had the idea for this update ever since mid-development of the main game. I was not sure if I would include it as a separate demo, content update or paid DLC. Now that I got a new boost of energy to work on games again, I decided to include it as a free update to thank all the players that supported Exophobia.
This is for you! Stay tuned!
Zarc
Hey everyone, seemed like there was a general crash on load games that would make the game unplayable. Hope it's fixed now, let me know.
Oops, so I managed to break the anniversary version. That's what you get to be a solo dev not testing after adding new content to the game...
Sorry all for the confusion, specially during the sale. New files should now be starting at the beginning.
Last patch of the year everyone!
Japanese localization by Hiroshi Ashida, a fan of the game that offered to help! If you would also like to translate the game to your language let me know!
Also, explore the 3rd floor during Christmas eve and day for a little festive surprise :)
New patch to fix the previous one that had a save file issue:
Better way to calculate play time - this might mess with your save files time, but it now fixes some problems where it was recording wrong. It also fixes displaying "0" in the save file on the menu.
Disabled drone in some boss fights where it can actually slow you down.
Infinite mode crash fix (I hope!)
All Our Base achievement fixed (I hope!)
Other small overall tweaks to values.
CD #41 now visible
This was a quick one, but I didn't want to leave you without a patch for much longer while I was away at Gamescom!
Infinite Mode Crash - let me know if you can get after level 3-3. I tested it but couldn't replicate the bug
Out of bounds bugs fixed in floor 4
Final achievement unlocks even if you get the good ending first, so you don't have to play the whole game again for the bad ending
Again, report everything you find in the Steam forums or Discord! Thanks a lot!
Sorry for taking so long to update! Tried to include a bunch of stuff:
Mouse acceleration fix - Let me know if it feels any different
Timers are now based on difficulty - Relax players now can take their time in these challenges
One way doors appear in the map - Dots that don't blink are one way doors. You can now plan your route with these in mind.
Achievement fixes - Some achievements were blocked due to bugs (On the Edge, Alien Slayer, Speedrunner, etc...), I think they are working now. Let me know if you still can't get them!
Localization changes
Out of bound errors fixed
Let me know in the Steam forums if your problem was fixed. Have fun!
Hotfix for the latest fix #2
Messed up the latest fix for the other fix. It's been a though week!
Fix for the latest fix lol
Spawning the ziplines on other floors by mistake.
Hotfix for softlock.
Players can now use the ziplines in the middle of floor 1 to go to the west elevator and to floor 2 to get the next upgrade necessary to progress.
Widescreen support
Resolution bug now fixed
Zarkonian Kill achievement fixed
Patch #3 - 29 July 2024
Level design changes on all floors for better orientation
Map Battery option - yep, this was causing more frustration than anything lol
Went back on Core boss - the move is too cool, I'll let players figure it out on their own
Key doors are now visible in the map - easier to know where to go when you got a card
Patch #2 - V1.0.5
Pressing a gamepad button/keyboard button changes control type - This was confusing some players that had connected gamepads and wanted to play with keyboard.
File Icon now appears on pause menu - This should help some players remember what the last major point in the game and help them progress.
Infinite mode crashes may not happen again? - Haven't tested properly but let me know if it crashes for you and what level that happens.
Kill all Zarkonians achievements is now tracked in the pause menu - Some players were confused on their progress with this achievement. It should be more clear now! Happy Zarkonian killing lol
Fixed water drain crash that happened if you died after using the valves but not saving before dieing.
Poisoned mode does not stay on if you pause the game
Core boss now opens eye after killing all drones - some players didn't know they could slide into the eyes. This is still possible and the fastest strategy but now players won't get stuck.
Explosions now destroy secret walls - makes secret hunting easier (thanks to Burr livestream)
Vending machine with filter now resets - a player had trouble finding the last filter because of this
Hello everyone!
Thank you all so much for giving Exophobia a chance on launch day! Hope you are all having a good time.
As expected, some bugs were found, as the game has never been played by this much people at the same time.

Fixed softlock issue found in the Steam forums - the hook that goes south always spawns on top. This is the only one that does this, but this was necessary so everyone that found this softlock can resume playing without starting a new save file. Sorry for the trouble.

Fixed game breaking in floor 3 at the robot ambush - some players were doing sequence breaks without noticing and the game broke because of it. Now it allows you to continue without activating the ambush and it's a new strat for speedrunners.
First attempt at a key rebind feature - you can find it in the options menu in the controls tab. Let me know if it is working for you PC players!
Removed "demo" from the window title.
Dashing through vines with jetpack no longer causes damage
Composer was renamed in the credits lol
A few level design changes to help navigation

Hey there!

As promised and part of FPS Fest, the demo has been sligthly improved to better reflect the quality of the final game. Testing has been crucial to find these small quirks and how to adjust them. You may not notice any differences, so let me present you the changes in this new version:
Some language errors fixed.
Disk image in the corner to indicate a loading time.
"Sci-fi" font option is now a more readable font in the terminal.
Map no longer starts to fade right away. Only when it reaches the last point in the battery.
Clickable buttons and levers now blink to indicate you can use an action on them.
You can now dash forward even if not holding a direction. Also, more i-frames!
Difficulty curve in the first part of the game has been adjusted. Less enemies before you get the first upgrade (for me where the fun of the game comes).

The boss now stays locked in the same vulnerable move until you hit. I made it that way so you can more easily guess what you have to do and so you don't have to wait until he cycles through all moves again to hit him.

Can't even tell how long I have been revising this first part of the game, but I know it's the most important part to get right, so I hope these changes please all of you and incentivize you to keep playing!
Let me know what you think.
More news coming soon!
Zarc
Hey everyone!
As I'm packing for a long trip to get to PAX East, I couldn't leave the rest of you without any new stuff.

So I uploaded a new version of the demo that has been available for quite a while. This new version just adds the general polish I've been working on lately for the conclusion of development, so no new features of course.
But go ahead and replay it, maybe you'll find hidden things ;)
Also, let me know of any bugs, as my testing has not been extensive ahah.
See you at PAX, and if not, have fun with the demo!
Zarc

releases.displayName: Steam Next Fest June 2022 - Demo Update

items.text: Hey everyone!
It's been a really hectic week, isn't it? Lots of demos, player feedback, and all of that. Hope you all have been having fun!
I just uploaded a new version of the demo, where I tried to fix all the game breaking bugs that appeared from all your gathered feedback and playthroughs I have been watching you share!

Saving system is working fine now. There was a key card door blocking the elevator room that sometimes disapeared, so you could just skip 80% of the demo by getting into the elevator sooner than normal. Yeah not very fun...
Found out a bug that randomly teleported you into a new game when pressing pause. Fixed now.
Boxes should not get stuck in the conveyor belts or flicker anymore, yay!
Tweaked the level a bit, so players wouldn't forget to save in the terminals as much. Please, save whenever you can, that's part of the game!

This new version includes a brand new performance system, so it might have some bugs, but run better. Let me know if the game crashes. Also, it's a known thing that if you have the window minimized on loading, it will show a warning, this is ok and will be fixed next update.
Among other many small tweaks for a better experience.
Thank you all for your patience, it's not fun to see people give up on the demo because of these bugs, but I'm doing my best!
And thanks to all of the commenters on the feedback discussion thread. If you are having trouble, feel free to write there or on the Zarc Attack Discord.
Have a great rest of the week!
Zarc

releases.displayName: Research & Destroy Demo Update for PAX West 2021

items.text: Hi, Zarc here!
People at PAX West have been playing an updated version of the demo, that includes an updated level layout and some bug fixes.
So why not share that version with you?

It's a very short demo showcasing one of the mid-section game levels in Exophobia, where you fight alien bees and worms in the spaceship laboratory. This update includes bug fixes and some extra polish, so might be cool to replay it again!
Let me know what you think, and as always, leave your feedback in the Steam thread!
Have fun,
Zarc

releases.displayName: PAX Online - Demo Update: Infinite Mode

items.text: The PAX Online Exophobia demo has been updated with a new mode, Infinite Mode, where you can now put your combat skills to the test in this room filled with infinite alien waves!
Think the demo is just too easy?
Fight for the highscore by killing as many aliens as possible with the charge gun and only two health points. Can you beat the dev score of 45 kills?
Enjoy the weekend with this new mode! Zarc
